lines: And you never see what they did.
segments.label: Intro
Handful
segments.headline: Small, real needs from *verified nonprofits.*
segments.sub: An iPhone app built with Expo and RevenueCat.

segments.label: Real needs
segments.headline: Priced *item by item.*
segments.sub: A hot meal and dry socks. A bus fare. A month of food for Toby. (Demo data.)

segments.label: Transparency
segments.headline: What it pays for. Who verified it. *What’s left.*
segments.sub: Every cause follows the same steps: verified, funded, bought, delivered.

segments.label: Complete it
segments.headline: Only $4 left. *One tap finishes it.*
segments.sub: A real RevenueCat purchase: consumable gifts in the Test Store, no real money.

segments.label: Your impact
segments.headline: Follow your gift *like an order.*
segments.sub: Funded, bought, delivered. Each gift keeps its RevenueCat transaction ID.

segments.label: Nonprofit
segments.headline: Every dollar reaches *the nonprofit.*
segments.sub: Released only when the goal is reached. Handful fee: $0. (Simulated payout.)

segments.label: Proof
segments.headline: Then it posts the receipt and *a thank-you photo.*
segments.sub: Two steps. Anything left over moves to its next cause.

segments.label: Privacy Shield
segments.headline: Faces blurred. Location removed. *On the phone.*
segments.sub: Apple Vision and Core Image run before anything is posted. Nothing is uploaded.

segments.label: Delivered
segments.headline: Everyone who gave *gets notified.*
segments.sub: The receipt, the note and the protected photo.

segments.label: The result
segments.headline: And you see *it got there.*
segments.sub: Proof that doesn’t cost anyone their dignity.

segments.label: Supporter
segments.headline: Nonprofits pay nothing. *Supporters keep it free.*
segments.sub: A RevenueCat subscription: offering, package and entitlement, with restore.
